text.en: An Italian missionary writes a Tamil epic.

Thembavani, composed by Constantius Beschi, known in Tamil as Veeramamunivar, is a Tamil epic on the life of St Joseph. Its name means a garland of unfading honey-sweet verses. The textbook includes a memorisation poem from it.
It shows that Tamil literature has been enriched by people of many cultures and religions.
Terms: தேம்பாவணி (unfading garland), வீரமாமுனிவர், காப்பியம் and மனப்பாடம்.
